name: @timurproko/addone
description: Standalone terminal workspace for supervised native and managed agents

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:architecture && npm test && npm run test:scenario
scripts.test:scenario: npm run build && vitest run test/scenarios/walking-skeleton.test.ts --testTimeout=30000
scripts.test:smoke:native-pi: npm run build && vitest run test/scenarios/native-pi-smoke.test.ts --testTimeout=30000

author: Timur Prokopiev
